policy.scope: All 101 unchanged actual questions graded independently for each reader against the frozen expected answers; authoritative appendix replaces approximate inline source locators.
policy.correct: Every actually requested material part is supplied, accepting semantic equivalents and reasonable contextual wording.
policy.partial: A requested material part is omitted or abstained from, without a false ruling.
policy.incorrect: A false gameplay ruling or material contradiction, including volunteered rulings.
policy.evidence: Each response is assessed with only its own same-question evidence. A bare section reference cannot supply a missing fact; another answer cannot repair it.
policy.support: Summary support is assessed independently of reader labels. A source-correct claim absent from the frozen summary would be flagged unsupported_guess separately.
policy.limits: Unasked incidental key background or convenient layout is not added as a new requirement. No expected answer or question was changed.

actual_reading_ranges.source_note: No disputed source semantics required additional primary-text or image inspection; the predetermined key and authoritative appendix were read completely.

independence_statement: This is a fresh independent assessment. Only the six authorized grading inputs were read. No prior score, grade, source-audit verdict, reviewer conclusion, repair finding, earlier summary or response, or other artifact was inspected. No readers or other graders were contacted. All 202 response/evidence pairs were inspected in bounded cases of no more than five; summary reading used no more than thirty lines per invocation. No input was edited and no helper file was created.
